title: Telugu Meanings for Bank Passbook English Words
title_te: బ్యాంక్ పాస్‌బుక్ ఇంగ్లీష్ పదాలకు తెలుగు అర్థాలు
problem: Amma looks at printed bank passbook words like "Withdrawal" or "Balance" and cannot tell if her subsidy money was deposited or not.
idea: A pocket dictionary for passbook words. Tap a word to see and hear its Telugu meaning. A quiz helps Amma practise reading a passbook line.

widgets.heading: 🎯 Try it: Tap a passbook word
widgets.intro: In my real project, Google Lens reads the passbook and Gemini explains it. Tap a word to hear it in Telugu.
widgets.question: Which word do you see in the passbook?

options.label: Deposit / Credit (Cr)
options.te: డిపాజిట్ / క్రెడిట్ = మీ ఖాతాలోకి డబ్బు వచ్చింది (జమ).

options.label: Withdrawal / Debit (Dr)
options.result: Money WENT OUT of your account.
options.te: విత్‌డ్రాయల్ / డెబిట్ = మీ ఖాతా నుండి డబ్బు బయటకు వెళ్ళింది.

options.label: Balance
options.result: Money left in your account now.
options.te: బ్యాలెన్స్ = ఇప్పుడు ఖాతాలో మిగిలి ఉన్న డబ్బు (నిల్వ).

options.label: DBT / Subsidy
options.result: Government money sent directly to your account (Direct Benefit Transfer).
options.te: డీబీటీ = ప్రభుత్వం నేరుగా మీ ఖాతాలో వేసిన డబ్బు.

options.label: Interest (Int.)
options.result: Small extra money the bank pays you for saving.
options.te: వడ్డీ = పొదుపుపై బ్యాంక్ ఇచ్చే అదనపు డబ్బు.

options.label: Charges
options.result: Money the bank took as a fee. Ask the bank if you don't understand.
options.te: ఛార్జీలు = బ్యాంక్ తీసుకున్న రుసుము. అర్థం కాకపోతే బ్యాంకులో అడగండి.

questions.why: Cr = credit = money came in. DBT = government money.

options: ₹2,000 was taken out at an ATM
questions.why: WDL = withdrawal, Dr = debit = money went out.

questions.q: Which column shows money left in the account?
questions.why: Balance is the amount still in the account.

questions.q: You see a charge you don't understand. What do you do?
questions.why: Bank staff must explain any charge.

items.title: Particulars / Narration
items.text: Short note on who sent or took the money.

items.title: Update passbook
items.text: Print new entries at the bank machine or counter.

how: Take a photo of a sample passbook page (hide the account number and name).
Use Google Lens to copy the English words from the photo.
Ask Gemini for the simple Telugu meaning of each word.
Make a 2-column list: English word → Telugu meaning, with a small icon.
Design pocket dictionary cards in Canva.
Print and laminate a card for Amma's passbook cover.
prompt: I am a Class 8 student. Give simple Telugu meanings with one-line explanations for these bank passbook words: Deposit, Credit (Cr), Withdrawal (WDL), Debit (Dr), Balance, DBT, Interest, Charges, Narration, NEFT, UPI. Make it easy for a mother who reads only Telugu.
